dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: High spatial density of small, solid light-colored pixel clusters without internal gradients concentrated on the posterior flank and along the lower dorsal-lateral interface.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: Geometric relationship characterized by an obtuse triangle formed by the centroids of the central 'O' annulus, the posterior 'C' annulus, and a distinct high-intensity blob located on the lower-mid flank.
